title: Spheres and hemispheres
goal: I can find the surface area and volume of spheres and hemispheres.
teach: Sphere: SA = 4πr² and V = 43πr³. A hemisphere is half a sphere: its volume is 23πr³ and its total surface is the curved half (2πr²) plus the flat circle (πr²).
tvis: SA = 4π(6)² = 452,39 cm².

ex.q: Find the surface area and volume of a sphere with radius 6 cm. Give answers correct to two decimal places.

watch: Cube the radius for volume; square it for area.

qs.text: The volume of a sphere with radius 3 cm
qs.steps:
1. Formulas (sphere): SA = 4πr²; V = 43πr³. Hemisphere: curved SA = 2πr²; V = 23πr³.
2. V = 43π(3)³ = 43π × 27 = 36π
3. = 113,10 cm³

qs.text: The total surface area of a solid hemisphere with radius 5 cm
qs.steps:
1. Formulas (sphere): SA = 4πr²; V = 43πr³. Hemisphere: curved SA = 2πr²; V = 23πr³.
2. Curved: 2π(5)² = 50π; flat circle: π(5)² = 25π
3. SA = 75π = 235,62 cm²

qs.text: The volume of a hemisphere with radius 6 cm
qs.steps:
1. Formulas (sphere): SA = 4πr²; V = 43πr³. Hemisphere: curved SA = 2πr²; V = 23πr³.
2. V = 23π(6)³ = 23π × 216 = 144π
3. = 452,39 cm³
